Package index

Components

Add these to a map created with mapgl::maplibre() or mapgl::mapboxgl().

add_view_summary()
Add an "in this view" summary panel to a map
add_view_ranking()
Add a ranking of the features in view
add_context_tooltip()
Add a tooltip that puts each value in context
add_feature_search()
Add a search box over the layer's own features

Texts

context_labels() view_summary_labels()
Texts for the context components
